QuickResponseContentProvider.description: The container of quick response content.

Content.description: The content of the quick response.

QuickResponseContentProvider.title: AWSWisdomQuickResponseQuickResponseContentProviderDefinition

QuickResponseContents.description: The content of the quick response stored in different media types.
QuickResponseContents.title: AWSWisdomQuickResponseQuickResponseContentsDefinition

GroupingConfiguration.description: The configuration information of the user groups that the quick response is accessible to.

Criteria.description: The criteria used for grouping Amazon Q in Connect users.

Values.description: The list of values that define different groups of Amazon Q in Connect users.

GroupingConfiguration.title: AWSWisdomQuickResponseGroupingConfigurationDefinition

GroupingValue.description: The value that define the group of Amazon Q in Connect users.
GroupingValue.title: AWSWisdomQuickResponseGroupingValueDefinition

Status.description: The status of the quick response data.
Status.title: AWSWisdomQuickResponseStatusDefinition

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -

Tag.title: AWSWisdomQuickResponseTagDefinition

ContentType.description:
The media type of the quick response content.
- Use application/x.quickresponse;format=plain for quick response written in plain text.
- Use application/x.quickresponse;format=markdown for quick response written in richtext.

KnowledgeBaseArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the knowledge base.

Name.description: The name of the quick response.

Channels.description: The Amazon Connect contact channels this quick response applies to.

Description.description: The description of the quick response.

IsActive.description: Whether the quick response is active.

Language.description: The language code value for the language in which the quick response is written. The supported language codes include de_DE, en_US, es_ES, fr_FR, id_ID, it_IT, ja_JP, ko_KR, pt_BR, zh_CN, zh_TW

ShortcutKey.description: The shortcut key of the quick response. The value should be unique across the knowledge base.

Tags.description: An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.
